note: Cases mirror the redis module of orbital-compiler tests/host_effects_validation.rs (control_well_formed_calls_raise_none_of_the_redis_codes, an_origin_outside_egress_is_undeclared_and_an_http_entry_never_authorizes_it, the_origin_is_a_redis_origin_without_a_path, an_origin_computed_at_run_time_is_static_only_when_egress_is_declared, the_command_is_a_non_empty_list_of_text, the_wrong_number_of_arguments_is_an_arity_error, the_options_are_closed_objects_that_share_one_namespace, a_user_needs_a_password_and_a_database_is_a_whole_number, the_key_is_a_non_empty_string). Each case runs the whole chain: the operator shapes, the walk, the plan and the real std-orb-emit-config answer. the_declared_success_payload_must_fit_what_redis_produces and the_reply_fits_a_declared_union (EmitPayloadNotProduced) are another rule and are not mirrored.
